g.text: Crow's foot. || = exactly one |o = zero or one o{ = zero or many
= mandatory (NOT NULL). _id is an INTEGER PRIMARY KEY (rowid alias) and can never hold NULL.
Every table is global except decks, the only table carrying user_id.
deck_questions has no user_id; deck ownership is only transitive, through decks.user_id.
No FK action above is enforced by the schema alone.
without it SQLite defaults PRAGMA foreign_keys = OFF and every CASCADE / SET NULL is inert.
No table declares a DEFAULT. No table is WITHOUT ROWID.
